title: arabis lyrata var. typica
intro: Arabis lyrata var. typica, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a perennial plant species native to North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis, and skin conditions like eczema. The health benefits of Arabis lyrata var. typica include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
